drawings.description: schéma de flèches incurvées, partant de $\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_{\Sigma\text{-sex}}$ vers $\mathcal{B}^{\bullet}$, puis de $\mathcal{B}^{\bullet}$ vers deux $\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_{\mathrm{sex}}$ dont les premiers arguments sont surchargés et biffés ; à gauche, une flèche courbe mène de $\mathcal{B}^{\bullet}$ à la ligne suivante, et une autre à « $\mathcal{B}^{\bullet}_{\mathrm{rés}}$ » (lecture incertaine) en bas ; l'accolade de droite relie la parenthèse sur $\mathcal{B}$ au dernier $\underline{\operatorname{Hom}}_{\mathrm{sex}}$
drawings.kind: scheme of curved arrows from Hom_{Sigma-sex} via B^. to two Hom_sex
drawings.notes: The sheet is upside down; redrawn upright on a tight crop (coordinates in the crop turned 180 degrees). Hom_{Sigma-sex}, a curved arrow down to B^.; from B^. curved arrows down-left (ending above the line "Hom_{Sigma-ex} = B^res") and down-right to Hom_sex, and from it to a second Hom_sex (their first arguments are overwritten and struck, left out); at the left a curved arrow from the line Hom_{Sigma-ex} = B^res down to "B^res" (uncertain reading, placed as on the page; it reads like B^{rés.le} or similar), the brace on the right joining the parenthesis on B (text) to the last Hom_sex. The arrows end in hooks on the page, drawn as arrowheads. Added: a thin stroke from a point beside B^res up towards the second Hom_sex (not in the transcription; its meaning is unclear). Left out: the long oblique stroke crossing the sheet (read as a strike of the page; it crosses the label B^res) and the text lines. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again. Question settled by a machine pass on the facsimile, 2026-11-12 (page): the long oblique stroke crosses the whole sheet, through unrelated lines above and below the scheme: it is a cancelling stroke, not part of the scheme, and stays left out. The thin stroke with a point beside the bottom label is a short straight pencil stroke of the same kind, without label; it stays drawn as on the page. Not checked by a reader.
drawings.orientation: sheet upside down; redrawn upright (crop rotated 180 degrees)
